title: A Risk-Based Oversight Framework for Service Providers
summary: How to build an oversight framework from the risks to the fund and its investors, covering the manager, administrator, transfer agent, depositary, distributors and auditors in proportion to risk.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: How to build an oversight framework from the risks to the fund and its investors, covering the manager, administrator, transfer agent, depositary, distributors and auditors in proportion to risk.
Learning Objectives: Identify the key risks each service provider presents to the fund
Apply proportionate oversight intensity based on risk and materiality
Define the assurance the board needs from each provider
Syllabus: Investor protection as the starting point for the oversight framework
Risk mapping across portfolio management, administration, depositary and distribution
Oversight intensity: reporting, reviews, due diligence visits and independent assurance
Tool: a risk-based service provider oversight matrix
Intended Audience: Chairs, independent and non-executive directors of investment funds and fund management companies
Executive directors, conducting officers and designated persons who prepare board business
Company secretaries and governance professionals who design and maintain board frameworks
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Current or prospective experience as a fund or management company director is helpful. No prior governance qualification is required.
Core Reading: IOSCO, Examination of Governance for Collective Investment Schemes (2006–2007)
FSB, Enhancing Third-Party Risk Management and Oversight: A Toolkit for Financial Institutions and Financial Authorities (2023)
FSB, Strengthening Governance Frameworks to Mitigate Misconduct Risk: A Toolkit for Firms and Supervisors (2018)
